What I Do

Three skills.

Most businesses hire a designer, a developer, and an SEO separately — and they don't talk to each other. I bring all three together, so your site looks great, loads fast, and gets found.

01 — DESIGN

Website Design

Modern, conversion-focused websites designed around your brand and your customer — not a generic template. Includes complete Blog websites built to publish, rank, and grow an audience — and complete LMS websites, so yes, I can build your online learning website too.

🔍
02 — SEO

SEO & Growth

Get found on Google and turn search traffic into customers with complete SEO — On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Guest Posting & Backlink Building — plus technical and content SEO that grows your authority and rankings.

  • Keyword research & strategy
  • On-Page SEO — titles, meta, headings, internal linking & content optimization
  • Off-Page SEO — authority building, brand mentions & digital PR
  • Guest Posting — quality guest posts on relevant, high-authority websites
  • Backlink Building — safe, white-hat, high-quality backlinks that boost rankings
  • Technical SEO, Local SEO & Google Business
  • Speed & Core Web Vitals
